steps.title: Prepare gelatin‑coated plates
steps.instruction: Make 0.1 % gelatin by dissolving 0.5 g gelatin in 500 mL distilled water, autoclave at 121 °C for 30 min, store at ~18 °C (1–2 mo) or 4 °C (6–8 mo). Coat each well of a 6‑well plate with 1 mL gelatin, incubate 37 °C ≥15 min, then aspirate before use.

steps.title: Prepare MEF‑coated plates
steps.instruction: Warm MEF medium to 37 °C, add 10 mL to a 15 mL Falcon tube. Thaw a MEF vial in a 37 °C water bath, transfer cells to the tube, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 6 mL MEF medium. Remove gelatin solution from the coated plates, add 2 mL MEF medium per well, then add 0.5 mL MEF suspension per well (25–30 000 cells / cm²; MEFs irradiated 30 Gy, 3.6 × 10⁶ cells per vial). Rock gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel‑coated plates
steps.instruction: Thaw a Matrigel aliquot at 4 °C, dilute in 25 mL cold KO‑DMEM, keep all tools on ice (‑20 °C). Dispense 1 mL per well of precooled 6‑well plates, seal with Parafilm and store at 4 °C (stable ≤2 weeks). Aliquot 200–350 µL of ES‑qualified Matrigel (per manufacturer) and store at –20 °C (≤6 months). Chill plates, pipettes and tubes before coating.

steps.title: Prepare CEPT cocktail stocks
steps.instruction: Dissolve Chroman 1, Emricasan and trans‑ISRIB each in 500 µL DMSO (10 000× stock). Pipet 200 µL of each (final 0.5 mM Chroman 1, 50 mM Emricasan, 7 mM trans‑ISRIB) into a 1.5 mL tube, mix, aliquot 10 µL, store at –80 °C. If trans‑ISRIB does not dissolve, heat 5 min at 60 °C and vortex. Dissolve Polyamine supplement in 5 mL distilled water (1 000×), filter 0.22 µm, aliquot 20 µL, store at –80 °C. For use, add 1 µL of the Chroman/Emricasan/trans‑ISRIB mix per 3 mL medium (3 300×) and 1 µL Polyamine per mL (1 000×).

steps.title: Thaw and plate hiPS cells on MEF
steps.instruction: Warm hiPS medium, add 10 mL to a 15 mL tube. Thaw hiPS cell vial in a 37 °C water bath, gently add cells to the tube, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in hiPS medium containing CEPT as needed. Aspirate MEF medium from the coated plates, wash each well with PBS (discard), add 2 mL hiPS + CEPT medium per well, distribute 500 µL cell suspension per well, rock gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. CEPT is only required for the first passage after thawing.

steps.title: Thaw and plate hiPS cells on Matrigel
steps.instruction: Warm iPS‑Brew and KO‑DMEM to ~18 °C, pre‑warm Matrigel‑coated plates at 37 °C. Add 10 mL KO‑DMEM to a 15 mL tube, thaw cells in a 37 °C water bath, add cells to the tube, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 3 mL iPS‑Brew + CEPT. Aspirate Matrigel solution from each well, add 1 mL iPS‑Brew + CEPT per well, distribute 500 µL cell suspension per well, rock gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Passage hiPS cells on MEF (Collagenase IV)
steps.instruction: Warm hiPS medium and Collagenase IV (1 mg/mL). Aspirate medium, add 1 mL Collagenase IV per well, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 20–60 min, watching for colony edges to roll up. Add 2 mL KO‑DMEM per well, rinse gently, collect clumps into a 15 mL tube, let settle 2–3 min (or centrifuge 4 min at 400 g), discard supernatant. After 70–80 % confluence, passage at 1:4 or 1:6. Aspirate MEF medium, wash with PBS, add 1.5 mL fresh hiPS medium per well, distribute cells 500 µL per well, rock gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Change medium daily: pre‑warm, discard old, add 2 mL fresh medium per well.

steps.title: Passage hiPS cells on Matrigel (Accutase)
steps.instruction: Warm iPS‑Brew, Accutase and KO‑DMEM. Pre‑warm Matrigel plates at 37 °C. Aspirate medium, add 1 mL Accutase per well, incubate 37 °C for 4 min. Add 2 mL KO‑DMEM per well, rinse, collect cells in a 15 mL tube containing 4 mL KO‑DMEM, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL KO‑DMEM + CEPT, count cells, transfer the desired number to a new Matrigel plate already containing 1.5 mL iPS‑Brew + CEPT per well, distribute evenly, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (recommended 1 × 10⁵ cells per well).

steps.title: Passage hiPS cells on Matrigel (EDTA clump split)
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm Matrigel plates at 37 °C. Aspirate iPS‑Brew, wash twice with 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS (1 mL per well), discard. Add 1 mL 0.5 mM EDTA/PBS, incubate 2 min at ~18 °C, aspirate, add 2 mL iPS‑Brew to a new Matrigel plate, aspirate EDTA solution, add 2 mL iPS‑Brew per well with a 10 mL pipette, resuspend only three times. Transfer split volumes according to ratio: 1:3 → 660 µL, 1:4 → 500 µL, 1:5 → 400 µL, 1:6 → 334 µL. Rock gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Colonies should reach ~85 % confluence in 3–5 days.

steps.title: Cryopreserve hiPS cells
steps.instruction: Warm hiPS medium and Accutase to 37 °C, pre‑cool cryopreservation medium. Aspirate medium, add 1 mL Accutase per well, incubate 37 °C for 4 min, add 2 mL KO‑DMEM per well, rinse, collect cells in a 15 mL tube, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, add CEPT cocktail to the cryopreservation medium, discard supernatant, gently resuspend pellet in cryopreservation medium, aliquot 1 mL per cryovial, place vials in a Mr. Frosty or Styrofoam box at –80 °C, then transfer to liquid nitrogen after 24 h for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Prepare FACS antibody master mixes
steps.instruction: For Day 14 (progenitor) combine CD45‑APC‑Vio770 (1:50), CD34‑PE (1:50), CD117‑FITC (1:100). For megakaryocyte panels (Day 14 & Day 18) combine CD45‑APC‑Vio770 (1:50), CD41/61‑FITC (1:50), CD42b‑APC (1:50), CD235a‑PE (1:50). Keep mixes on ice or at 4 °C and prepare fresh.

steps.title: Form spin embryoid bodies (EBs)
steps.instruction: After ≥2 passages, warm iPS‑Brew, Accutase and KO‑DMEM to 37 °C. Aspirate old medium, add 1 mL Accutase per well, incubate 37 °C 4 min, add 2 mL KO‑DMEM per well, rinse, collect cells, pass through a 0.70 µm strainer into a 50 mL tube containing 5 mL KO‑DMEM, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL KO‑DMEM + CEPT, count, resuspend 2 × 10⁶ cells in 5 mL KO‑DMEM + CEPT, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, discard supernatant, resuspend in 20 mL Day‑0 Spin EB medium. Using a multichannel pipette add 50 µL cell suspension to each well of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate, centrifuge plate 400 g for 5 min (low acceleration/deceleration). Verify cells are packed in the well centre; repeat centrifugation if needed. EB formation is visible after 48 h.

steps.title: Differentiate EB to progenitors and megakaryocytes
steps.instruction: Day 2: add Day‑2 Spin EB medium to each well. Days 3–8: perform daily partial medium changes with Day‑3‑8 medium. Days 8–10: daily partial changes with Day‑8‑10 medium. Days 10–14: daily partial changes with Day‑10‑14 medium, removing ~75 µL each day and adding fresh cytokine‑containing medium.

steps.title: Harvest and expand EB‑derived cells
steps.instruction: Day 14: harvest EB and progenitors with a 1 mL pipette tip, collect in a 50 mL tube, centrifuge 4 min at 400 g, resuspend in Day‑10‑14 medium. Seed at 1 × 10⁶ cells / mL (e.g., in a 6‑well plate or 10 cm dish). Day 16: add 5 mL fresh medium. Day 18: perform a full medium change—harvest, spin, resuspend in 10 mL fresh Day‑10‑14 medium. Continue feeding as needed; monitor progenitor morphology (≈Day 8) and megakaryocyte maturation.

steps.title: CellTiter‑Glo assay for drug testing
steps.instruction: Resuspend harvested cells at 115 000 cells / mL in Day‑10‑14 medium (90 µL ≈10 000 cells). Prepare five serial‑dilution tubes: Tube 1 – 100 µM (495 µL solvent + 5 µL 10 mM stock); Tube 2 – 10 µM (450 µL solvent + 50 µL Tube 1); Tube 3 – 1 µM (450 µL solvent + 50 µL Tube 2); Tube 4 – 100 nM (450 µL solvent + 50 µL Tube 3); Tube 5 – 10 nM (450 µL solvent + 50 µL Tube 4). Vortex each tube, keep on ice. Dispense 10 µL of each compound (triplicate) into a 96‑well U‑bottom plate; add 90 µL cell suspension, incubate 66–72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Equilibrate plate 15 min under a hood, add 100 µL CellTiter‑Glo reagent, incubate 30 min at ~18 °C, transfer to an opaque flat‑bottom plate, read luminescence, and analyse with GraphPad Prism.

steps.title: Prepare cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest up to 1 × 10⁶ cells, centrifuge 5 min at 400 g, resuspend in 1 mL FACS buffer, vortex, centrifuge 5 min at 400 g, discard supernatant, resuspend in 100 µL FACS buffer, add 5 µL human TruStain FcX, incubate 5 min at ~18 °C. Add 100 µL of the appropriate antibody master mix, vortex, incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark. Add 1 mL FACS buffer, vortex, centrifuge 5 min at 400 g (wash 1), discard supernatant, repeat wash, then resuspend in 350 µL FACS buffer. If required, starve cells by resuspending 1 × 10⁶ cells in 1 mL RPMI + 1 % L‑Glu + 1 % P/S (no cytokines) for 1.5 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, then centrifuge 5 min at 400 g and keep cold before staining.

steps.title: Acquire and analyze flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Load .fcs files into FlowJo, add keywords (e.g., Genotype, Treatment, Concentration). Create a “Cells” gate then a “Singlets” gate, apply the Singlets gate to all samples (Select → Select equivalent nodes). Export/concatenate populations as FCS3, include keywords, no spread, choose a new workspace. In the workspace, plot histograms, use “Select gates on peaks” to define populations. Gate CD45 vs CD235a for red cells, CD45 vs CD41/61 for immature megakaryocytes, then CD42b for mature megakaryocytes; copy/paste gates across samples. Run the tSNE plugin with fluorophores CD45‑APC‑Vio770, CD41/61‑FITC, CD235‑PE, CD42‑APC, using 1000 iterations. Edit the tSNE plot (tSNE_1 vs tSNE_2), overlay colors, duplicate plots for each sample, adjust color boxes, and interpret differences in mature megakaryocyte populations.

steps.title: MACS isolation of CD61⁺ megakaryocytes
steps.instruction: Harvest Day 14 progenitors/megakaryocytes, pass through a 100 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL tube, wash the strainer with 10 mL PBS (~18 °C) and collect cells by centrifugation 5 min at 400 g. Resuspend pellet in 10 mL PBS, centrifuge 5 min at 400 g, then fill the tube with 10 mL ice‑cold MACS buffer. Perform magnetic‑activated cell sorting with CD61 microbeads according to the manufacturer’s protocol, collect CD61⁺ cells, count, and proceed to downstream assays (e.g., co‑culture, RNA isolation, ELISA, flow cytometry).
